verdict.rationale: Baseten's hosted Model APIs are documented only for language models, with OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible chat endpoints. Non-text models are reachable only by deploying them yourself: Truss explicitly supports `diffusers` and any Python framework, so image-generation and other custom models can run as dedicated endpoints on the same platform. missing for 10: hosted multimodal Model APIs callable without deployment, explicit documentation of vision, audio, or image-generation inference endpoints, independent hands-on corroboration of multimodal use.
